messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: change-window v1.45.0 blocked — ci-cache restore thundering herd: 6/8 artifact restores timed out, build 4099 smoke failed. Auto-promote paused. Logs: /ci/4099.
Ivy: Oof. Is this cache node eviction or a transient provider outage?
Noah: Metrics show a big spike in concurrent restores after CI rerun. cache nodes overloaded, 503s then timeouts.
Priya: Change window ends in ~22m. Two paths: (A) wait and retry (est ~15m) or (B) manual-promote last-stable v1.44.7 to keep the window. Thoughts?
ReleaseManager: Prefer safe route — manual-promote v1.44.7 for this window. We can follow up with a postmortem and fix cache autoscaling/backpressure.
Ivy: +1. If we manual-promote, do a 2% canary first and keep rollout throttled. Document the reason in release notes.
ci-bot: note: auto-promo remains BLOCKED until cache error rate <1% for 30m. Manual-promote requires ReleaseManager approval token.
Priya: Running manual promote now: `/deploy promote --tag v1.44.7 --canary 2%` (triggered by ReleaseManager approval).
deploybot: :robot_face: manual promote accepted. Canary 2% started, smoke window 10m. Manual override: `manual_promote_by=Priya; reason=ci-cache_thundering_restore; ticket=CLOUD-11555`.
Noah: Canary passed first 6m. Platform metrics look healthy. Holding 4 more minutes then scale to 25%.
Ivy: Adding release note: "Promoted v1.44.7 due to ci-cache restore overload causing artifact timeouts for v1.45.0. Follow-up: improve restore backpressure and auto-throttle CI retries."
ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-460: add limiter on restore concurrency and improve cache autoscale policy. Assigned to Noah.
ReleaseManager: OK to proceed to full rollout once canary window completes. Postmortem owner assigned: Noah. Auto-promo remains BLOCKED. Closing hold for this window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
